# Compatibility and recorded validation

<!-- Generated by scripts/update_support_status.py; edit src/rsi_eval/data/support_status.json. -->

Reviewed 2026-10-11. Recorded integration evidence on macOS arm64 with Docker/Colima. Catalog coverage, execution prerequisites and observed runs are separate. No full benchmark scores or paper reproduction are claimed. Evidence records retain their original source hashes and historical limits; this index does not assert that every run used the current implementation.

Use the same packaged index from the CLI or Python. These commands make no model calls, start no containers and inspect no credentials.

```sh
rsi-eval status --benchmark terminal-bench@2.0 --method rrsi
rsi-eval status --benchmark gpqa --json
```

```python
from rsi_eval import support_status

record = support_status(benchmark="drop@1.0-agent", method="ahe")
```

An exact `name@version` selects one configuration. A bare benchmark name returns every catalog version, including labeled legacy subsets. Unknown names and versions fail explicitly. Process-local custom registrations appear as unreviewed. This index describes recorded evidence; use `check` to inspect the current runtime.

`observed` means the stated check executed for the named scope. It does not imply a passing task reward, score improvement, a full dataset run or a new check of the current source tree. `not_recorded` means this index has no such execution evidence. `blocked` names an unmet prerequisite; `unavailable` identifies an absent native reference.

All bundled methods have reusable execution adapters. That establishes an integration route, subject to task requirements and explicit objective mapping. It does not establish a run of every method and benchmark pair. Tool-only evidence does not count as a scored trial or an evolution loop.

## Shared runtime requirements

- Python 3.12 or newer and Harbor 0.18.0 in its execution environment.
- Working Docker/Compose with the task image architecture; macOS uses a Linux VM.
- Target model access and task-specific assets; subscription access does not supply native judge credentials.

## Method objectives and actual runs

### meta-harness

Codex adaptation of upstream `8123ccabe2b19fa1123090b2e5f1bacc20963ce8`. Codex wrapper through Harbor, including task-provided MCP.

| Input modality | Transport support |
| --- | --- |
| text | Supported by the Codex adaptation |
| image | Target-defined; no method-level image transport validation recorded |
| audio | Target-defined; no method-level audio transport validation recorded |
| video | Target-defined; no method-level video transport validation recorded |

Execution limits:

- The selected target and task tools determine input handling; a Harbor execution adapter does not establish every media capability.
- Native method gates, task budgets and runtime prerequisites remain in force.

| Benchmark reward domain | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| binary | native objective |
| unit_interval | explicit binary score mapping required |
| heterogeneous | explicit binary score mapping required |

Native validity and selection gates remain mandatory; explicit selection callbacks may choose only eligible measured candidates.

Recorded scopes:

- `terminal-bench@2.0`, `observed`, `evolve`, tasks `extract-elf`: Two native rounds with two real changed candidates, feedback use and completed benchmark evaluations. [validation-meta](validation-meta.json).
- `terminal-bench@2.1`, `observed`, `final_test`, tasks `extract-elf`: Selected artifact completed one independent cross-version task trial. [validation-meta](validation-meta.json).
- `swe-bench-verified@1`, `observed`, `final_test`, tasks `astropy__astropy-12907`: Selected artifact completed one independent SWE-bench Verified trial. [validation-meta](validation-meta.json).

Every other method/configuration pair has no recorded execution in this index. The shared adapter and objective policy remain available for user-selected experiments.

### harnessx

Codex adaptation of upstream `915520584c92cc35ed24aef1af17eec1d60c0b01`. HarnessX native processors/tool loop with Harbor MCP bridge.

| Input modality | Transport support |
| --- | --- |
| text | Supported by the Codex role transport |
| image | Static PNG, JPEG and WebP through native Codex image attachments; PNG exercised live, format handling checked offline |
| audio | Unsupported; no transcription fallback |
| video | Unsupported |

Execution limits:

- GIF and animated PNG/WebP are unsupported; rejected media that reaches the provider stops before another model call.
- Transport limits: 20 MiB per image and 64 MiB per turn. The native tool-result budget is 200,000 characters including base64; that stage can remove oversized images with a notice before the provider receives them.
- Remote URLs and local-path media blocks are rejected. Native task MCP images and embedded image resources use the same validated attachment route.
- Native method gates, task budgets and runtime prerequisites remain in force.

Capability evidence, `static_image_input`, `observed`: A synthetic native HarnessX tool returned two PNG images; two real Codex calls completed the tool-to-image-to-model path. JPEG/WebP parsing and MCP media routes have offline checks. Scope: Synthetic transport smoke with zero benchmark calls and zero judge calls; not a scored benchmark pair or method evolution run. [validation-harnessx-images-20261011](validation/harnessx-images-20261011.json).

| Benchmark reward domain | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| binary | native objective |
| unit_interval | native score range; caller chooses a meaningful objective |
| heterogeneous | finite score; declare objective and selection for unlike task metrics |

Native validity and selection gates remain mandatory; explicit selection callbacks may choose only eligible measured candidates.

Recorded scopes:

- `terminal-bench@2.0`, `observed`, `evolve`, tasks `extract-elf`, `log-summary-date-ranges`: Two native model-driven rounds completed as valid no-ops; history and smoke paths ran. This did not show a model-generated change. [validation-method-expansion](validation-method-expansion.json).
- `terminal-bench@2.1`, `observed`, `final_test`, tasks `extract-elf`: Selected artifact completed one independent cross-version task trial. [validation-method-expansion](validation-method-expansion.json).
- `terminal-bench@2.0`, `observed`, `functional_changed_candidate`, tasks `log-summary-date-ranges`: A hand-authored change passed native gates and a real scored trial; its reminder reached the actual model request. This is separate from the model-driven no-op rounds. [validation-harnessx-functional-20261010](validation/harnessx-functional-20261010.json).
- `apex-agents@1.1.1`, `observed`, `tool_route_only`, tasks `128-jr-1-f7f95d92`: Read-only MCP discovery/listing and close in one real world, without model calls or paid grading. No method loop or scored trial is established. [validation-harnessx-functional-20261010](validation/harnessx-functional-20261010.json).

Every other method/configuration pair has no recorded execution in this index. The shared adapter and objective policy remain available for user-selected experiments.

## Maintain the index

The packaged source is `src/rsi_eval/data/support_status.json`. It pins each complete catalog specification and method upstream revision. Catalog changes, missing configurations, unknown task scopes and broken evidence references fail validation. Source-tree tests also verify each historical receipt hash. Review evidence before updating these values.

```sh
python scripts/update_support_status.py
python scripts/update_support_status.py --check
```

The generator never reruns an experiment. CI checks the generated page against the packaged data. Evidence links refer to repository summaries; some raw logs named in those receipts remain in private local run directories. The index packages their paths and hashes, not those raw artifacts. Wheels work without the documentation directory.
